## 更新内容

- 优化软著生成的代码文件清单，排除文件列表固定高度展示，表头吸顶，超出内容可在框内滚动，适合大型项目文件较多的场景。
- 重构专利生成四个页面的排版，包括专利挖掘、交底书生成、查新分析和修订迭代，使主操作区更突出，减少重复表单和大面积空白。
- 案件信息仅在专利挖掘页完整维护，其他专利页面通过顶部案件概览复用共享信息。
- 将“流程规划”从主内容卡片调整为顶部轻量入口，点击后弹窗查看，让结果、交付物和编辑区域拥有更多展示空间。
- 优化按钮排布、卡片等高、内部滚动和响应式布局，提升专利生成模块的整体视觉一致性。

## What's Changed

- Improved the software copyright code file list with a fixed-height scrollable area and sticky header, making large projects easier to review.
- Refined the patent generation layouts across patent mining, disclosure drafting, prior-art analysis, and revision iteration, making primary work areas clearer and reducing repeated forms and empty space.
- Kept the full patent case form only on the patent mining page, while other patent pages reuse the shared case summary in the hero area.
- Moved workflow planning out of the main content grid into a lightweight top-level trigger with a modal detail view, freeing more space for results, deliverables, and editors.
- Polished button alignment, card sizing, internal scrolling, and responsive behavior for a more consistent patent generation experience.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
